changelog: Brand-new login page: 3D CMYK cube artwork, cursive 'Welcome Back!', icon input fields with show/password toggle, Remember Me, feature badges, and a vibrant 'WE PRINT WHAT YOU THINK' panel — fully responsive on mobile and desktop.
Bundled a local cursive font (no external CDN) so the login heading renders everywhere.
Public home hero now carries the same 3D CMYK cube identity for a consistent, premium printing-press look.
Tip: set your brand colour to red in Settings to match the reference exactly.
